name: Transportation and Environmental Services (Streets)
about: The Streets Department plans traffic systems and handles street maintenance, traffic engineering, sidewalk, curb and gutter construction and repair, street lighting, and traffic signs and markings.

director.name: Michael Rattler
director.title: Director of Transportation and Environmental Services

speed.title: 25 MPH on your street
speed.detail: To ask for a 25 MPH speed limit on a City street, fill out the Neighborhood Speed Modification request and City policy documents and mail them to Public Works, 401 Laureate Way.

projects.name: Little Texas Road sidewalk
projects.detail: About 1.5 miles of sidewalk on the east side of Little Texas Road and Ruth Avenue, Dale Earnhardt Blvd to Lane Street, with intersection and roadway improvements. Right-of-way is being bought; delayed by Duke utility easements; 16–18 months once under way.

projects.name: Bethpage Road sidewalk
projects.detail: A 7-foot sidewalk with curb, gutter and drainage on the south side of Bethpage Road, from South Main to Leonard Avenue and from Westgreen Drive to Klondale Avenue.

projects.detail: New sidewalk on North Main Street.
